shared_elements: geometric incised/relief linear motifs on the body or head
horizontal or curved banding below the face
justification: Both surfaces show a centrally placed, frontal, highly schematic anthropomorphic figure/face with paired eyes, a central mouth/nose area, and geometric linear banding beneath or around the face. The biggest difference is that B presents a clear standing monolithic figure with a distinct head, torso, and chest bands, while A appears more like a less clearly bounded relief face/figure with its surrounding forms and body parts much harder to identify.
